# Ting (Vincent) Lu

> Personal website of Ting (Vincent) Lu, a project manager in Utrecht who grew up in China and has lived in the Netherlands since 2015. Stories from work and from moving countries, and some notes.

## Pages

- [About](https://vincentluting.github.io/about/): where I come from, what I like doing, and things I made
- [Stories](https://vincentluting.github.io/stories/): a few stories from work
- [Blog](https://vincentluting.github.io/posts/): notes on AI, work and living between China and the Netherlands
- [How I run a project](https://vincentluting.github.io/how-i-work/): what a new manager or teammate can expect from me

## Stories from work

- [I taught myself to build web tools so my team could work faster](https://vincentluting.github.io/stories/amazon-vendor-tickets/): Amazon, 2019 – 2021
- [Being the IT partner for three game studios](https://vincentluting.github.io/stories/tencent-studios/): Tencent, 2023 – 2024
- [From one small dashboard idea to four dashboards for Philips](https://vincentluting.github.io/stories/philips-amazon-marketing-cloud/): Philips via OMD, 2021 – 2023

## Things I made
